Awkwardly dropping to his side. A slight blush appeared on his face, his eyes showing a mix of embarrassment and helplessness.

※3⛬, originally full of joy, was waiting for its master's petting. It habitually closed its eyes, tilted its head slightly, and even had a hopeful smile on its face, ready to fully enjoy that familiar comfort and warmth.
